data.name: Virtual Program
data.headline: Explore Boston history from home with our winter Virtual Programs!
data.description:
Explore Boston history from home with our engaging 2026 Virtual Experiences! Please register for the dates of the individual programs you'd like to attend. Check your confirmation email for a unique webinar link to access the virtual program.

- Thursday, January 15 - Boston By Foot Turns 50! A conversation with Boston By Foot’s longest-serving volunteers
- Wednesday, January 21 - Autumn in Montpellier, France with Amisi Nazaire-Hicks
- Thursday, January 29 - Interpreting Democracy: Creating a New Tour for America at 250 *BBF Members exclusive event*
- Monday, February 2nd - The Rise and Fall of the Thomas G. Plant Shoe Factory in Jamaica Plain with Marilynn Johnson
- Tuesday, February 10th - Community Showing of “Redline Narratives: “The Lost Cultural Hubs of Boston” with Marlon Solomon
- Wednesday, February 18th - Historic Bridges of Boston with Dan Keating
- Tuesday March 3 - Researching Resting Places: Creating New Tours in Boston’s Burying Grounds  *BBF Members exclusive event*
- Monday March 9 - Food, Glorious, Food: Morsels of History from the Omni Parker House Kitchens

data.cancellation_notes:
- Please arrive at least 10 minutes early to meet your guide. Late admittance is not guaranteed. 
- Public tours can be rebooked on another available tour, or canceled for full credit as a gift card, with at least 24hrs notice. Customers can conveniently cancel or rebook public tour registrations using the "change booking" and "cancel booking" links in the confirmation and reminder emails. Cancellations less than 24hrs prior to the tour start or no shows cannot be credited.
- Private tours can be canceled up to 4 days before the start for a full refund. Private tour cancellations made within 4 days of the tour date incur a small cancellation fee, though they can be rebooked for no additional fees. Contact us to cancel or rebook a private tour. 
- All tours are held in all weather - rain or shine. Please be prepared for the weather and to walk and stand outdoors on your tour. In case of tour cancellation by Boston By Foot due to extreme weather or unforeseen circumstances, you will be offered a refund or exchange. If groups choose to cancel a tour due to weather, the above policy stands.
